howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求深入解释某个代码组件时，Claude 会先查找知识图谱，定位目标节点，分析其连接关系、架构层和源代码，然后从架构角色、内部结构、外部连接、数据流等方面给出详细解释。
howto.when: 当您需要深入理解代码库中的某个具体文件、函数或模块时触发。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 文件
say.note: Claude 会分析该文件的知识图谱节点和源代码。

say.text: 说明一下 verifyToken 函数的作用
say.note: Claude 会找出函数节点及其调用关系。

say.text: 深入分析这个模块的架构角色
say.note: Claude 会结合层信息解释模块定位。

howto.what_en: After installation, when asked to deeply explain a code component, Claude will first check for a knowledge graph, locate the target node, analyze its connections, architectural layer, and source code, then provide a detailed explanation covering role, structure, connections, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze its knowledge graph node and source.
Claude finds the function node and its relationships.

say_en.text: Deep dive into this module's architectural role
say_en.note: Claude uses layer info to explain its position.
